FULL TEXT:
UNIVERSITY INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERUNG AND TECHNOLOGY
PANJAB UNIVERSITY, CHANDIGARH- 160014, INDIA
Advertisement
Announcement and applications are invited for Post Doctoral Fellowship (PDF)- 01 under
“Visvesvaraya PhD scheme for Electronics & IT- Phase II”, by Digital India Corporation
(DIC), MeitY, Govt. of India.
Salient Features and Eligibility Criteria of the PDF:
 Research Fellowship @Rs. 1.08 Lakh/Month period of one year
 Contingency- Rs. 1 Lakh for one year
 Maximum age of the applicant must be 50 Years as on last date of nomination
submission.
 Mentor/Guide of applicant nominee must hold a PhD degree in relevant area and
regular academic/research position in CSE/ECE/IT branches of UIET.
Further all scheme related details are also given on UIET website. Candidates are required to
fill the application form (attached) and upload online at link of Google form
https://forms.gle/3rTvDAhSyJSJJUf8A.
Last date of submission of application is 15th April 2024. Details are also given on the
following websites https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/list-jobs.php and
https://uiet.puchd.ac.in/?page_id=3175
